atScene.en: When a limb is pulseless distal to a fracture, BC allows one careful realignment attempt toward the anatomical position: pulse returns → treat as stable; pulse stays absent → treat as unstable and load-and-go.
atScene.zh: 骨折远端肢体无脉时，BC 允许小心地做一次复位尝试、把肢体调回解剖位置：脉搏恢复则按稳定处理；仍无脉则按不稳定处理，立即装载转运。

atScene.en: Pelvic binder placement is a landmark test, not a general area: centre it on the greater trochanters, never roll the patient to get it under them, and reach for a commercial binder or three overlapping broad triangular bandages — never zap straps.
atScene.zh: 骨盆固定带的位置是精确解剖标志，不是大概区域：中心对准大转子，绝不为了穿带而翻滚患者，只用商品化固定带或三条宽三角巾重叠——绝不用扎带。

atScene.en: Once traction is applied to a Sager or Hare splint, it never gets released in the field — reassess and correct it with every movement and every set of vitals instead of loosening it to 'check.'
atScene.zh: Sager 或 Hare 牵引夹板一旦上了牵引，院前绝不放松——每次移动和每组生命体征时都要复查并校正，而不是为了「看看」就松开。

atScene.en: Compare every finding bilaterally — deformity, swelling, colour, pulse strength, sensation. A subtle abnormality is often only obvious next to its mirror image.
atScene.zh: 每一项发现都要双侧对比——畸形、肿胀、颜色、脉搏强弱、感觉。细微的异常往往只有对比健侧才看得出来。

atScene.en: Never probe an open fracture wound trying to retrieve debris and never push an exposed bone end back under the skin — both actions drive contamination deeper without changing the transport plan.
atScene.zh: 绝不为了取出碎屑而探查开放性骨折的伤口，也绝不把外露的骨端推回皮下——这两个动作只会把污染推得更深，对转运计划毫无帮助。

atScene.en: BC's musculoskeletal pain ladder has no opioids in it: Entonox plus oral acetaminophen and ibuprofen (PCP) is the full toolkit, and it should go in BEFORE splinting whenever the patient is stable enough to wait for it to take effect.
atScene.zh: BC 的肌骨镇痛阶梯里没有阿片类：Entonox 加口服对乙酰氨基酚和布洛芬（PCP）就是全部工具，只要病人稳定到能等药起效，就应该在夹板固定之前给药。

atScene.en: A splint that's firm enough to immobilize can still occlude circulation — check the distal pulse right after you finish securing it, not just at the next scheduled vitals check.
atScene.zh: 夹板固定得够牢固，也可能同时压闭了循环——固定完成后应立刻检查远端脉搏，而不是等到下一次常规生命体征复测。

atScene.en: If an elderly or osteoarthritic patient's limb resists straightening for splinting, or their pain spikes when you try, stop and splint in the position found — forcing it risks a new injury on top of the old one.
atScene.zh: 老年或骨关节炎患者的患肢若在拉直固定时遇到阻力，或疼痛骤增，应立即停止，改为原位固定——强行拉直可能在旧伤之上再添新伤。

confusions.en: The '6 Ps of musculoskeletal assessment' (Pain, Paralysis, Paraesthesias, Pulselessness, Pallor, Pressure) and the '6 Ps of compartment syndrome' (Pain, Paraesthesia, Paresis, Pressure, Passive-stretch pain, Pulselessness) are two DIFFERENT lists for two different purposes — don't answer one with the other's items.
confusions.zh: 「肌骨评估六个 P」（疼痛、瘫痪、感觉异常、无脉、苍白、张力）和「筋膜间室综合征六个 P」（疼痛、感觉异常、肌力减退、张力增高、被动牵拉痛、无脉）是用于不同目的的两套不同清单——不要把两者的条目张冠李戴。

confusions.en: 'The patient can still move/use it, so it's not fractured' — false; ability to use an injured part does not rule out a fracture. Likewise, 'no tenderness on palpation, so no injury' is unreliable in intoxicated patients or those with a spinal cord injury, where tenderness can be masked.
confusions.zh: 「还能动/还能用，所以没骨折」——错，能活动并不能排除骨折。同样，「按压没压痛所以没伤」在醉酒或脊髓损伤病人身上也不可靠，这类病人的压痛表现可能被掩盖。

confusions.en: 'Open fractures are safe from compartment syndrome because the pressure has somewhere to escape' — this is an explicitly named misconception; open fractures can develop compartment syndrome just like closed ones.
confusions.zh: 「开放性骨折压力有地方释放，所以不会得筋膜间室综合征」——这是教材明确点名的误区；开放性骨折和闭合性骨折一样都可能并发筋膜间室综合征。

confusions.en: A displaced HIP FRACTURE classically shows an EXTERNALLY rotated, shortened leg. A posterior HIP DISLOCATION classically shows the opposite rotation — flexed, adducted, and INTERNALLY rotated, also shortened. Same general picture (pain, can't bear weight, shortened leg), opposite rotation direction — that's the detail an exam question will hinge on.
confusions.zh: 移位性髋部骨折典型表现为患肢外旋并缩短。髋关节后脱位典型表现则相反——屈曲、内收、内旋，同样缩短。整体画面相似（疼痛、无法负重、肢体缩短），但旋转方向相反——这正是考题会卡住人的细节。

confusions.en: 'Ice and heat are interchangeable comfort measures' — false; cold is the right call in the first 48 hours (vasoconstriction, less swelling), but heat in that same window can make pain and swelling WORSE. Heat only helps later, once the injury's vessels have already clotted.
confusions.zh: 「冰敷和热敷都是让病人舒服一点的手段，随便用」——错；伤后 48 小时内应该用冷敷（血管收缩、减轻肿胀），同一时间窗内用热敷反而可能让疼痛和肿胀更重。热敷只有在损伤血管已经凝血之后才有帮助。

confusions.en: Traction splints are not a universal femur-fracture tool: they are contraindicated with an additional fracture at or below the knee on the same limb, and contraindicated with a suspected pelvic fracture — applying one anyway can worsen both injuries.
confusions.zh: 牵引夹板不是万能的股骨骨折工具：同侧肢体在膝或膝以下另有骨折时禁用，疑似骨盆骨折时也禁用——硬上牵引夹板反而可能让两处损伤都恶化。

mnemonics.name: FOOSH 传导链
mnemonics.en: A fall on an outstretched hand can injure anywhere along one chain: scaphoid (direct) → Colles fracture of the distal radius/ulna → elbow fracture-dislocation → shoulder fracture-dislocation → clavicle fracture. Tenderness anywhere on the chain means screen the whole thing.
mnemonics.zh: 跌倒手撑地的力沿一条链传导，可能伤在链上任何一点：舟状骨（直接撞击）→桡尺骨远端 Colles 骨折→肘关节骨折脱位→肩关节骨折脱位→锁骨骨折。链上任一点有压痛，就要筛查整条链。

mnemonics.name: STAPLES
mnemonics.en: Sager/Hare traction splint steps: Size beside the uninjured leg, Thigh strap, Ankle harness above the malleoli, Padding, Lbs of traction (10% body weight, max 15 lbs closed / 5 lbs open), Elevate the splint's foot end to neutral alignment, Straps — three elasticized straps with a blanket between the legs.
mnemonics.zh: Sager/Hare 牵引夹板步骤：Size 靠健侧腿量长度、Thigh 大腿带、Ankle 踝部吊带置于踝骨上方、Padding 加衬垫、Lbs 牵引重量（体重 10%，闭合上限 15 磅/开放上限 5 磅）、Elevate 抬高夹板尾端至中立对线、Straps 三条弹性绑带并在两腿间垫毯。

mnemonics.name: SOUP 与 CAR/TAR
mnemonics.en: A SUPinated hand can hold a cup of SOUP (palm up = supination). You steer your CAR(pal) with your hands and walk through TAR(sal) with your feet — carpals are wrist bones, tarsals are ankle bones.
mnemonics.zh: 手掌旋后（supinate）时能端起一碗汤（SOUP，即手心向上＝旋后）。用手驾驶 CAR（腕骨 carpal），用脚走过 TAR（跗骨 tarsal）——腕骨在手腕，跗骨在脚踝。

mnemonics.name: PRICED（本章复用）
mnemonics.en: The same closed-injury ladder from Ch.22 governs sprains, strains, Achilles rupture, tendinitis, and bursitis here too: Protect, Rest, Ice, Compression, Elevate, consider analgesic Drugs.
mnemonics.zh: 第 22 章的闭合伤处理口诀在本章同样适用于扭伤、拉伤、跟腱断裂、腱鞘炎和滑囊炎：保护(Protect)、休息(Rest)、冰敷(Ice)、加压(Compression)、抬高(Elevate)、考虑镇痛药(Drugs)。

mnemonics.name: 骨盆三型态
mnemonics.en: Pelvic-ring patterns by what happens to the ring's volume: lateral compression SHRINKS it (less hemorrhage risk), anterior-posterior 'open-book' OPENS it (massive hemorrhage risk), vertical shear SHIFTS it vertically (shortening plus high hemorrhage risk).
mnemonics.zh: 骨盆环三种型态按容积变化记：侧方挤压使容积变小（出血风险相对低）、前后挤压「开书样」使容积大开（出血风险高）、垂直剪切使骨盆垂直错位（肢体缩短且出血风险高）。

selfCheck.qEn: A 70 kg patient has a suspected closed mid-shaft femur fracture. Using STAPLES, roughly how much traction weight do you apply, and what's the hard ceiling?
selfCheck.qZh: 一名 70 kg 病人疑似闭合性股骨干骨折。按 STAPLES，大约该加多少牵引重量？硬性上限是多少？
selfCheck.aEn: 10% of body weight ≈ 7 kg (about 15 lbs) — which happens to land right at the ceiling. The hard maximum for a closed mid-shaft fracture is 15 lbs (7 kg); an open mid-shaft fracture caps at only 5 lbs.
selfCheck.aZh: 体重的 10% ≈ 7 kg（约 15 磅）——刚好落在上限附近。闭合性股骨干骨折的硬性上限是 15 磅（7 kg）；开放性股骨干骨折上限仅 5 磅。

selfCheck.qEn: You're binding a suspected unstable pelvis. Where exactly does the binder centre go, what material is banned, and what movement must you avoid while applying it?
selfCheck.qZh: 为疑似不稳定骨盆上固定带。带子中心对准哪里？什么材料被禁止？上带时必须避免什么动作？
selfCheck.aEn: Centre it on the greater trochanters (not the iliac crests). Zap straps are explicitly not acceptable. Never roll the patient to get the binder underneath them.
selfCheck.aZh: 中心对准大转子（不是髂嵴）。明确禁止使用扎带。绝不能为了把固定带穿到身下而翻滚患者。

selfCheck.qEn: A forearm fracture looks grossly deformed and the radial pulse is absent distally. What does BC guidance allow you to do, and what determines whether you then treat the patient as stable or unstable?
selfCheck.qZh: 一处前臂骨折明显畸形，远端桡动脉无脉。BC 指南允许你做什么？之后判定稳定还是不稳定的依据是什么？
selfCheck.aEn: One gentle attempt to realign the limb toward the anatomical position. If the pulse returns, treat as stable; if it stays absent, treat as unstable and prioritize rapid transport.
selfCheck.aZh: 允许做一次轻柔的复位尝试，把肢体调回解剖位置。若脉搏恢复，按稳定处理；若仍无脉，按不稳定处理，优先快速转运。

selfCheck.qEn: Your PCP-level femur-fracture patient is stable and in severe pain before you splint. What's the full BC drug list you can reach for, and what's conspicuously absent compared with what the textbook lists?
selfCheck.qZh: 一名 PCP 级别的稳定股骨骨折病人，夹板前剧痛。BC 允许用哪些药？和教材列出的药单相比，明显缺了什么？
selfCheck.aEn: Entonox plus oral acetaminophen (500-1,000 mg) and ibuprofen (300-400 mg) — give them before splinting. Conspicuously absent: any opioid. The textbook lists fentanyl and morphine as prehospital options, but BC's EMR/PCP formulary has zero opioid analgesics for this indication.
selfCheck.aZh: Entonox 加口服对乙酰氨基酚（500-1,000 mg）和布洛芬（300-400 mg）——在夹板固定前给药。明显缺席的是任何阿片类药物。教材把芬太尼和吗啡列为院前选项，但 BC 的 EMR/PCP 药单在这个适应症上完全没有阿片类镇痛药。

selfCheck.qEn: Two patients each have a shortened leg after trauma: one has flexion/adduction/internal rotation, the other has external rotation. Which is the hip dislocation and which is the hip fracture?
selfCheck.qZh: 两名外伤病人都有患肢缩短：一个是屈曲/内收/内旋，另一个是外旋。哪个是髋关节脱位，哪个是髋部骨折？
selfCheck.aEn: Flexion, adduction, and internal rotation with shortening = classic posterior hip DISLOCATION. External rotation with shortening = classic displaced hip FRACTURE. The rotation direction is the tell.
selfCheck.aZh: 屈曲、内收、内旋伴缩短＝典型的髋关节后脱位。外旋伴缩短＝典型的移位性髋部骨折。旋转方向就是鉴别点。

bcAlerts.bookEn: Lists narcotics (fentanyl, morphine), acetaminophen, NSAIDs, nitrous oxide, and ketamine as prehospital analgesic options for orthopedic pain, without flagging any of them as out of scope.
bcAlerts.bookZh: 教材把阿片类（芬太尼、吗啡）、对乙酰氨基酚、非甾体抗炎药、笑气和氯胺酮都列为院前骨科镇痛选项，没有标注任何一项超出执业范围。
bcAlerts.bcEn: BC's EMR/PCP formulary contains ZERO opioid analgesics for this indication (confirmed: morphine, fentanyl, and hydromorphone all return no hits in the guideline). The actual protocol is a non-narcotic triple: Entonox (p.65, classified 'Non-Narcotic Analgesia') plus PCP-level oral acetaminophen 500-1,000 mg (p.58) and ibuprofen 300-400 mg (p.68), given BEFORE splinting whenever the patient is stable enough to wait.
bcAlerts.bcZh: BC 的 EMR/PCP 药单在这一适应症上完全没有阿片类镇痛药（已核实：吗啡、芬太尼、氢吗啡酮在指南中零命中）。实际协议是非阿片三联：Entonox（p.65，分类为「非麻醉性镇痛」）加 PCP 级口服对乙酰氨基酚 500-1,000 mg（p.58）和布洛芬 300-400 mg（p.68），只要病人稳定到能等药起效，就应在夹板固定之前给药。
bcAlerts.ref: BC Guidelines p.58 Acetaminophen, p.65 Entonox, p.68 Ibuprofen

bcAlerts.topicZh: 夹板前的无脉肢体复位
bcAlerts.bookEn: Describes gentle longitudinal traction to realign a severely angulated long-bone fracture 'to improve circulation,' but does not tie this to an explicit stable/unstable classification rule.
bcAlerts.bookZh: 教材描述用轻柔纵向牵引复位严重成角的长骨骨折以「改善循环」，但没有把这一操作和明确的稳定/不稳定判定规则挂钩。
bcAlerts.bcEn: One gentle realignment attempt toward the anatomical position is permitted specifically when a limb is pulseless distal to an injury. If the pulse returns, treat the patient as stable; if it stays pulseless, manage as unstable (load-and-go).
bcAlerts.bcZh: 当伤口远端肢体无脉时，BC 明确允许做一次轻柔的复位尝试、把肢体调回解剖位置。若脉搏恢复，按稳定病人处理；若仍无脉，按不稳定处理（立即装载转运）。
bcAlerts.ref: BC Guidelines p.19 Wound Care footnote 2; p.21 Musculoskeletal Injuries

bcAlerts.topicEn: Pelvic binder landmark and banned materials
bcAlerts.topicZh: 骨盆固定带解剖标志与禁用材料
bcAlerts.bookEn: Says to wrap the binder or sheet around both the anterior superior iliac spines AND the greater trochanters, without naming any banned binding material or an explicit no-roll instruction.
bcAlerts.bookZh: 教材说固定带或床单要同时绕过髂前上棘和大转子，没有点名任何禁用材料，也没有明确的「不得翻滚」指示。
bcAlerts.bcEn: BC centres the binder on the GREATER TROCHANTERS specifically (not the iliac crests/ASIS). Zap straps are explicitly NOT an acceptable binding material — only a commercial binder or three overlapping broad triangular bandages. Never roll the patient to apply it. Contraindications also include a suspected neck-of-femur (hip) fracture and falls from standing height or other simple falls.
bcAlerts.bcZh: BC 明确要求固定带中心对准大转子（不是髂嵴/髂前上棘）。明确禁止使用扎带作为固定材料——只能用商品化固定带或三条宽三角巾重叠。上带时绝不能翻滚患者。禁忌还包括疑似股骨颈（「髋部」）骨折，以及平地站立高度跌倒等简单跌倒。

bcAlerts.topicZh: 牵引夹板重量百分比公式
bcAlerts.bookEn: Describes traction splints only in general terms — 'apply gentle longitudinal traction' — and never gives a weight formula tied to the patient's body weight anywhere in this chapter's traction-splint discussion.
bcAlerts.bookZh: 教材对牵引夹板只做笼统描述——「施加轻柔纵向牵引」——本章讨论牵引夹板时从未给出与病人体重挂钩的重量公式。
bcAlerts.bcEn: BC requires the STAPLES-mnemonic weight formula by heart: closed mid-shaft femur fracture = 10% of body weight to a MAXIMUM of 15 lbs (7 kg); open mid-shaft fracture = maximum 5 lbs. Once traction is applied, it is never released in the field, and it must be reassessed and corrected with every movement or set of vitals.
bcAlerts.bcZh: BC 要求熟记 STAPLES 口诀中的重量公式：闭合性股骨干骨折＝体重的 10%，上限 15 磅（7 kg）；开放性股骨干骨折＝上限 5 磅。牵引一旦施加，院前绝不放松，且每次移动或每组生命体征都要复查并校正。
bcAlerts.ref: BC Guidelines p.23 Fracture Management – Traction Splint

bcAlerts.bookEn: Frames hip dislocation as a high-energy injury needing a full trauma assessment, but leaves the actual transport-priority decision to the general assessment findings (shock, mechanism, etc.) rather than stating a blanket rule.
bcAlerts.bookZh: 教材把髋关节脱位定位为需要完整创伤评估的高能量损伤，但把实际的转运优先级判定留给一般评估结果（休克、机制等），没有给出统一规则。
bcAlerts.bcEn: BC states a blanket rule: ALL hip dislocations are Rapid Transport Category (RTC), regardless of neurovascular findings. Isolated hip FRACTURES, by contrast, are only RTC if there is neuro or vascular impairment — the dislocation/fracture distinction changes the transport call by default.
bcAlerts.bcZh: BC 给出的是一条统一规则：所有髋关节脱位都属于快速转运类别（RTC），无论神经血管检查结果如何。相比之下，孤立性髋部骨折只有在合并神经或血管损伤时才属于 RTC——脱位还是骨折的区分，会直接改变默认的转运判定。
